thread:
anya: Quick triage thread for a weird drift after converting Gemma->Nimble 13B with head permutation + int8. Long-context QA and summarization quality dropped, posting numbers and repro. :mag:

sam: Drop the eval snapshot and minimal repro please.

anya: Eval mini-snapshot:
```
Llama-13B fp16 baseline:    ROUGE-L 37.1 | QA EM 72.3 | Instr 94.3
Nimble-13B int8 (converted): ROUGE-L 34.9 | QA EM 68.0 | Instr 87.8
```

anya: Repro (conversion + eval):
```bash
python tools/convert_model.py --src-format gemma --dst-format nimble --in /models/gemma13b/ --out /tmp/nimble13b/ --permute-heads --tok-map ../token_maps/gemma->nimble.json
python infra/eval.py --model /tmp/nimble13b/int8 --tasks summarization,qa --batch 8 --max-len 2048
```

clare: Two suspects: rotary freq/head remap or token-id offset in tok-map.

dave: +1 on tok-map off-by-one; seen that cause sentinel/quote shifts. Run tokenizer id diff for a few punctuation samples.

matt: Also run KV-cache head-correlation test: permuting heads without adjusting rotary/KV layout will show drop in per-head cosine when extending context.

anya: Bisect result: if I drop `--permute-heads` outputs match baseline. With permute we diverge. So conversion permutation step is likely bad.

sam: Sounds like projection-slice->head mapping mismatch. Conversion should emit a mapping from original head index to permuted slice.

clare: Quick diagnostics: layer-0 embedding cos sims for sample tokens: 0.997, 0.991, 0.889 (tail). Tail falling to 0.89 suggests remap or quantization amplifying a permute error.

dave: Tokenizer check: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('vocab.json'); print(t.encode('—').ids)"`  compare across both vocabs and run small collision scan.

matt: KV align script: `python tests/kv_align.py --model /tmp/nimble13b/int8 --prompt-prefix-file tests/short_prefix.txt --extend 1024`  expect low per-head key cos for permuted issue.

anya: Temporary mitigation: reorder rotary tables after load to match permuted projection ordering and renormalize freq scaling: `model.rotary.freq = model.rotary.freq.reshape(heads, -1)[perm]`. This recovers ~+1.2 ROUGE-L in my local run.

sam: Two follow-ups: conversion should write `rotary_map.json` when permuting heads; and add a unit test that verifies a handful of deterministic tokens and a short prefix consistency check.

clare: Also try preserving rotary tables in fp16 while quantizing rest; that isolates quantization amplification.

anya: I did that: keeping rotary fp16 recovers most of the instruction-following score (gap narrows to ~-1.4). So quantization amplifies the permutation error.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4921 with logs and eval artifacts.

matt: Actions:
- anya: PR that emits rotary_map + tests.
- matt: run KV-head battery on Dedicated and upload plots.
- clare: audit tok-map for multibyte/punctuation collisions.
- sam: schedule quant sweep (fp16-rotary vs int8-rotary).

anya: Will open PR and add reproducer gist; will add "emit rotary_map" to onboarding checklist after landing.

sam: Once PR lands I'll run the quant sweep and A/B against Llama baseline.

anya: Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-dev/nimble13b/triage/1762223333/ if you want raw eval dumps.

anya: Closing for now, will update when PR merged and infra run completes. :thumbsup:
